notes: Exact Bowers & Wilkins 803 D4 manufacturer information sheet. It specifies a 3-way vented-box system with one 25 mm Diamond tweeter, one 130 mm Continuum FST midrange, and two 180 mm (7 in) Aerofoil bass units (four transducers total). Published frequency response is 19 Hz–28 kHz (±3 dB from the reference axis); sensitivity is 90 dB SPL on-axis at 2.83 Vrms/1 m; nominal impedance is 8 Ω (minimum 3.0 Ω). The sheet gives a 50–500 W recommended-amplifier range, not speaker power handling, so the scalar power field remains N/A. No response points or directivity data are imported. Source: https://www.bowerswilkins.com/on/demandware.static/-/Library-Sites-bowers_northamerica_shared/default/dwdf0b2886/downloads/803D4-Information-Sheet.pdf.
